notes: Places you've been. Every new place you visit gets a postcard: its name, the date and weather, who was with you, and a line about what it was like. On the 🗺 World map, districts you've been to are marked 📍 and the rest stay dim until you explore them. 🧰 Tools → 📮 Places shows your postcards (tap one to jump back to that moment) and the places you visit most.
